headline: MAS Chief Economist Says AI Productivity Gains Could Guide Accommodative Policy
summary: Monetary Authority of Singapore chief economist Edward Robinson indicated central banks could lean toward accommodative policy via a data-dependent approach as AI productivity gains take root.
why: Central bank views on structural productivity improvements from AI influence long-term interest rate models and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Anticipated supply-side productivity gains may provide central banks greater room to ease monetary conditions.
